amendment.reason: record the failed independent v1.4 source gate, remove its unsupported global covariance-monotonicity claim, freeze a production-default counterexample, restore the older v5 materializer byte-for-byte, and retain the validated heteroscedastic likelihood contracts

aggregation.event: one material identity at one untouched future frame
aggregation.first_stage: equal-weight mean over valid 3D marginal events within each physical-object-session
aggregation.second_stage: equal-weight mean over the 24 locked physical-object-sessions

estimands.gaussian_nll: for each 3D identity-frame event, 0.5*(3*log(2*pi)+logdet(Sigma_total)+(y-mu)^T Sigma_total^-1 (y-mu)); Sigma_total=Sigma_predictive+(0.005 m)^2 I
estimands.marginal_3d_nees: for each 3D identity-frame event, (y-mu)^T Sigma_total^-1 (y-mu), with calibrated expectation 3
estimands.marginal_90_percent_ellipsoid_coverage: event indicator that marginal_3d_nees is at most chi2_3(0.90)
estimands.marginal_interval_width: per-event volume of the 90 percent 3D Gaussian ellipsoid computed from Sigma_total

evaluation.mean_identity_check: compare candidate and registered last_residual point arrays directly for equal dtype, shape, C-order bytes, and SHA-256 before any score
evaluation.primary_endpoint: equal-object-session mean 3D marginal Gaussian NLL difference, covariance-only candidate minus last_residual

predecode_blocker_regressions.ambiguous_midpoint: 0/10 mm candidate midpoint yields +5/-5 mm innovations and assignment covariance that survives into the forecast
predecode_blocker_regressions.conditional_covariance_semantics: the production-default robust model average consumes metric row covariance and cue reliability, returns PSD covariances, and intentionally makes no global Loewner-monotonicity claim
predecode_blocker_regressions.distant_rows: 17 m rows yield zero valid support, zero updates, and exact fallback
predecode_blocker_regressions.downstream_uncertainty: 1000x row covariance and 10x lower cue reliability both alter the production-default forecast; a deterministic counterexample prevents interpreting this as a global covariance-ordering guarantee

causal_residual_history.association: candidate geometry supplies deterministic soft association; no state residual is converted into prior perception reliability
causal_residual_history.association_semantics: geometry supplies assignment probability and admission only; association probability is not prior perception reliability
causal_residual_history.endpoint_likelihood: provider-specific full-covariance robust model average: for component k, R_eff=(R_tn+sigma_obs,k^2 I)/prior_reliability; the outlier component applies its registered variance multiplier; no pre-mixture innovation clipping
causal_residual_history.frame_contract: one row for every permitted causal prefix frame in exact increasing order
causal_residual_history.identity_contract: one fixed material-identity ordering shared by physical prefix, residual history, candidate mean, covariance, and score
causal_residual_history.missingness: invalid identity-frame entries remain valid_mask=false with zero storage and are never nearest-filled as observations
causal_residual_history.prior_reliability: source confidence, mask distance, overlap disagreement, and 1/sqrt(contributor_count); independent of state innovation and consumed once
causal_residual_history.posterior_covariance_semantics: each reported covariance is PSD; changing row covariance or reliability may change robust responsibilities and component evidence, so separately conditioned posteriors need not be Loewner-ordered
causal_residual_history.row_covariance: source point covariance in m^2 plus assignment-mixture spread plus 4e-6 m^2 isotropic floor; consumed by the heteroscedastic endpoint likelihood

covariance.operation: Sigma_candidate(h,n)=multiplier(h)*Sigma_independent_endpoint_v1(h,n) only for empirically admitted identities; otherwise exact fallback covariance
covariance.scale_interpretation: multipliers apply to covariance, not standard deviation

fallback.case_support_failure: exact fallback mean and covariance bytes
fallback.identity_below_update_count: exact fallback covariance for that identity
fallback.mean: registered last_residual mean, or unchanged physical mean when the causal residual itself is unavailable

observation_partition.camera_partition_algorithm: sort camera IDs by SHA256(namespace+NUL+object_session_hash+NUL+camera_id); even ranks are provider and odd ranks are scoring

stage_order: preserve the v1.2 selection, exact file plan, download, verification, and quarantine artifacts without rewriting them
preserve the superseded v1.4 protocol and its failed independent source-only gate
pass and commit the corrected conditional-covariance source-only provider dry run
commit this v1.5 amendment before any target decode
obtain independent source-only contract review of v1.5
materialize deterministic names-only provider/scoring camera partitions for all 24 locked sessions
build provider and scoring reconstructions independently from their disjoint camera panels
seal all candidate and fallback forecasts before opening any custom scoring reconstruction
score the complete 24-session denominator with retained technical failures
